query: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with Nvidia on 17 November 2026. Cover what changed in the last 30 days (news, launches, hires, deals), cite a source URL for every fact, and end with three open questions to ask.
briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: NVIDIA, 17 November 2026

**Window covered:** roughly 18 Oct to 15 Nov 2026, based on the search results provided. Results are dated up to 15 Nov.

## Leadership change (dominant story)

- Jensen Huang has resigned as chairman, chief executive and director, with immediate effect. Colette Kress, CFO since September 2013, is interim CEO and remains CFO until a successor is chosen. (https://meteoraweb.com/en/news/nvidia-jensen-huang-steps-down-as-ceo)
- The board announced the resignation on 12 Nov 2026. (https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/11/12/business/nvidia-jensen-huang-resigns)
- The board has started a search and will evaluate internal and external candidates. (https://meteoraweb.com/en/news/nvidia-jensen-huang-steps-down-as-ceo)
- On 8 Nov the board said it had "confidence in Jensen and his leadership team." (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors)
- The board said it would investigate after Huang admitted an affair. The NYT reports he also had a relationship with Kimberly Powell, a Nvidia vice president who reports to him. (https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/11/12/business/nvidia-jensen-huang-resigns)
- Wired reported (per an aggregator headline only) that Nvidia hired a crisis PR firm at least a year before Huang acknowledged the affair. I could not verify the article body. (https://mezha.net/eng/news/mezha-cbe54f11b05c0e59be5a05db_wired-_nvidia_hired)

## Deals and partnerships

- A report dated 15 Nov says a company "has agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion," citing people familiar with the matter, with closing expected next quarter. The source does not name the company. Do not assume it is Nvidia. (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced)
- A company profile lists Nvidia acquisitions including Hugging Face (1 Aug 2026, $12.90B), Kumo.AI (1 Jun 2026, $400M) and Illumex Technologies (1 Feb 2026, $60M). The page is undated, so these may not all fall in the 30-day window. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/TXRhn2TKUD7t)
- Nvidia, Rebellions and SK Telecom announced a collaboration on sovereign AI infrastructure using NVLink Fusion, dated 8 Nov 2026. Only the headline was available. (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition)
- An AWS and Nvidia announcement describes AWS deploying 2 million additional Blackwell Ultra, Rubin and Rubin Ultra GPUs across 2027 and 2028. Rubin reportedly moved into production shipments in H2 2026. (https://shattered.io/gpu-vs-tpu-vs-npu-ai-chip-camps-compared-2026)

## Launches and product

- Vera Rubin NVL72 debuted in Nvidia's MLPerf Inference v6.1 results in September 2026. (https://shattered.io/gpu-vs-tpu-vs-npu-ai-chip-camps-compared-2026)

## Hires and personnel

- Kress is interim CEO. The board has not named a permanent successor in the sources. (https://meteoraweb.com/en/news/nvidia-jensen-huang-steps-down-as-ceo)
- President Trump posted on social media that Tim Cook, former Apple CEO, should replace Huang. This is a political comment, not a board decision. (https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/11/12/business/nvidia-jensen-huang-resigns)

## Timing note

- Nvidia is scheduled to release quarterly results around 4:20 p.m. ET on Tuesday 17 Nov, with an earnings call at 5 p.m. ET. It is the first call since Huang's exit. (https://mashable.com/tech/jensen-huang-affairs-nvidia-resignation-timeline)

## Gaps

- I could not find the body text of the board's 10 Nov statement from the independent members. (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition)
- I found no source confirming Nvidia's role in the Globex deal or any outcome of the board investigation.

## Open questions

1. What is the timeline and shortlist for the permanent CEO search, and will Kress keep the CFO role alongside interim CEO?
2. What is the status and scope of the board investigation, and does it affect any other executives or commitments?
3. Given today's earnings call, how is the Rubin ramp and the AWS 2027–2028 GPU commitment tracking, and has guidance changed?
